title: Amazon Bedrock token pricing
description: Contract for skills/shared/ai/bedrock-pricing.json, the single source of truth for Bedrock Standard on-demand token rates per model and inference-profile prefix. llm-to-bedrock's bedrock_pricing.py reads the vendored copy. tests/test_bedrock_pricing_data.py checks what the schema cannot: rows in bedrock-pricing-cache.md agree with these rates.

models.description: One entry per priced model, keyed by its bare Bedrock model id (no inference-profile prefix).

source.description: Where the rates were read: a public AWS URL, or a repository file for rates copied from a verified table.

verified_at.description: Date the rates were last checked against the source.

long_context.description: Higher tier for a request whose prompt exceeds threshold_tokens. A caller that does not know the request-size distribution must show both tiers.

region_rates.description: Rates that replace the commercial ones in a specific Region (for example GovCloud), keyed by Region code.

prefixRates.description: Rates keyed by model-id form: `bare` (no prefix) or a cross-Region inference profile prefix. A prefix absent here is unverified.
